questions.title: Read authority
questions.prompt: What company information may AI read?

questions.title: Draft authority
questions.prompt: What may AI prepare without approval?
questions.recommendation: Drafting is usually lower risk than external execution.

questions.title: Communication authority
questions.prompt: What may AI send externally without human approval?
questions.recommendation: Separate transactional, sales, support, public, legal and sensitive messages.

questions.title: System write authority
questions.prompt: What records may AI create or update?

questions.title: Financial authority
questions.prompt: May AI quote prices, refund, spend, invoice or initiate payments?

questions.title: Destructive authority
questions.prompt: May AI delete, cancel, revoke, terminate or permanently modify anything?
questions.recommendation: Default: no irreversible action without approval.

questions.title: Approval matrix
questions.prompt: Which actions require approval, from whom, and at what threshold?
questions.recommendation: Make it deterministic enough for software enforcement.

questions.title: Abstention rules
questions.prompt: When must the system refuse to act and escalate?
questions.recommendation: Missing context, low confidence, policy conflict, high risk, novelty.

questions.title: Confidence thresholds
questions.prompt: What evidence/confidence is required for autonomous action?

questions.title: Prohibited actions
questions.prompt: What must AI never do even if requested?
questions.recommendation: Record legal, ethical, contractual, brand and safety prohibitions.

questions.title: Sensitive data
questions.prompt: What data requires special access, masking, residency, retention or handling?
questions.recommendation: Include customer, finance, HR, minors, legal, credentials as relevant.

questions.title: Auditability
questions.prompt: What must be logged for each significant AI decision/action?
questions.recommendation: Actor, time, event, evidence, policy, action, result, approval.
